business_summary: Clenergy Technology Co., Ltd. operates in photovoltaic mounting sector in China and internationally. The company offers solar mounting system, energy storage system, and cable management system for residential, commercial, and utility sectors. It also provides pitched roof, flat roof, balcony, carport, fixed tilt, inverter, EV charger, and tracking system. In addition, the company is involved in research, design, production, and sales of distributed photovoltaic (PV) brackets, fixed PV brackets, and intelligent PV trackers; investment, development, construction, and operation of PV power plants; research, development, production, and sales of PV power electronic products; and provision of smart energy solutions. It offers its products to the distributors, developers of key regional projects, owners, and mainstream customers. The company was formerly known as Clenergy (Xiamen) Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Clenergy Technology Co., Ltd. in July 2022. Clenergy Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Xiamen, China.

The company was formerly known as Clenergy (Xiamen) Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Clenergy Technology Co., Ltd. in July 2022.
